campaign.title: Vitatherapy Welcome Series (New Lead Nurture)
campaign.description: 5-email automated welcome sequence for new leads. Sends: Day 0, 2, 4, 7, 10. Email 4 uses placeholder testimonials pending real quotes.
campaign.html_content:
A little hello from Katie and the heart behind Vitatherapy.
 ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
 
Welcome to Vitatherapy

Care that starts
with knowing you

Hi, I’m Katie, and I’m so glad you’re here.

I’m a registered nurse with 16 years of clinical experience, and I created Vitatherapy to bring wellness and aesthetics together in one warm, personal space.

This is the kind of place where you can exhale, ask every question, and feel truly heard. We’ll talk about how you want to feel and look, then create a plan that feels right for you.

I’ve personally experienced the services I offer, and our products are sourced in the United States. You can expect honest guidance, thoughtful follow-up, and care that never feels rushed.

Feeling like yourself again can be a beautiful place to begin.
EXPLORE ALL SERVICES

In the next email, I will help you find the best place to begin.

 

Katie Jones, RN

Founder, Vitatherapy Wellness Spa

emails.title: Welcome 2 of 5: Start With How You Want to Feel
emails.html_content:
Four common goals and the Vitatherapy services that can support each one.
 ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
 
Your Care Map

Start with how
you want to feel

Think of this as your little care map. Start with what you want more of: energy, confidence, balance, or simply feeling more like yourself. You don’t need to know which treatment to book before we talk.

01   Energy + Hydration

Feel Replenished Again

IV therapy and injectable vitamins can support hydration, energy, recovery, and immune wellness.
02   Skin + Confidence

Look Refreshed Naturally

Hydrafacials, Botox, RF microneedling, and RF laser are tailored to your skin and aesthetic goals.
03   Metabolic Health

Reach Your Goals

Medically supervised GLP-1 options and peptides are personalized after an appropriate evaluation.
04   Hormone Balance

Understand Your Changes

BHRT begins with lab work, a consultation, and a plan designed around your results and symptoms.

And if you checked more than one box, you’re in good company. Many clients come to us with a mix of goals, which is exactly why every visit begins with a real conversation.

BOOK A CONSULTATION
 

Katie Jones, RN

Founder, Vitatherapy Wellness Spa

28677 Old Town Front St, Suite F, Temecula, CA 92590
(951) 397-7444  •  @vitatherapy_katie

emails.title: Welcome 3 of 5: Memberships Made Simple
emails.html_content:
Compare Feel Good, Feel Great, and Feel Fantastic monthly memberships at a glance.
 ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
 
Memberships Made Simple

A simple plan
for staying consistent

A single appointment can give you a lovely reset. A membership makes it easier to keep that good feeling going, with a set monthly allotment of 500mL IV treatments, your choice of three vitamins in each IV, injections, and savings on other services.

Feel Good
$199/mo wellness plan
 

2 IV treatments

10% off other services

1 B12/MIC injection
Feel Great
$299/mo wellness plan
 

3 IV treatments

15% off other services

1 vitamin injection
Feel Fantastic
$399/mo wellness plan
 

4 IV treatments

20% off other services

2 vitamin injections

Every included IV uses 500mL of fluid and includes your choice of three vitamins. NAD+ IV therapy is not included. Each membership is a fixed monthly allotment, not unlimited treatment.

Choose the rhythm that feels right for you: Feel Good for a simple routine, Feel Great for a little more flexibility, or Feel Fantastic for your most consistent care and best service savings.
FIND YOUR MEMBERSHIP

Questions? Call (951) 397-7444 and we will talk through the tiers with you.

 

Katie Jones, RN

Founder, Vitatherapy Wellness Spa

emails.title: Welcome 4 of 5: Four Standout Ways to Begin
emails.html_content:
A simple guide to four popular starting points for wellness and aesthetics.
 ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
 
Your Treatment Guide

Four standout ways
to begin your care

Your best starting point is the one that fits your body, your goals, and your life. Here are four patient favorites that can help you feel refreshed, supported, and beautifully cared for.

Your First-Visit Bundle

Vita Welcome Bundle

$275 complete bundle

Signature Hydrafacial, vitamin injection, and Hydration IV.
Aesthetic and Wellness Care

Refresh and Elevate Program

Botox treatments: $10/unit
Xeomin treatments: $8/unit
RF microneedling treatment: $500
Complimentary GLP-1 and BHRT screening

Personalized IV Therapy

Goal-based options for hydration, energy, immune support, recovery, detox, and whole-body wellness.

Signature Hydrafacial Care

Signature, Gold, and Platinum options for cleansing, smoothing, and a refreshed-looking complexion.

Personalized GLP-1 Support

Personalized, medically supervised options for eligible adults pursuing weight and metabolic health goals.

Botox Skin Treatments

Botox, RF microneedling, and RF laser can be combined thoughtfully for smoother, firmer-looking skin.

Love more than one option? We can create a thoughtful sequence without trying everything at once. Your plan should feel exciting, comfortable, and completely your own.

SEE ALL SERVICES
 

Katie Jones, RN

Founder, Vitatherapy Wellness Spa

28677 Old Town Front St, Suite F, Temecula, CA 92590
(951) 397-7444  •  @vitatherapy_katie

emails.title: Welcome 5 of 5: Your Next Step
emails.html_content:
A simple first visit, an honest recommendation, and a plan that fits your goals.
 ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
 
Your Next Step

You do not have
to figure it out alone

By now, you’ve seen what makes Vitatherapy feel different: nurse-led care, wellness and aesthetics under one roof, and a team that wants you to feel comfortable, confident, and cared for.

Your first visit can be refreshingly simple.

Your First Simple Step
Tell Us How You Want to Feel
More energized, refreshed, balanced, confident, or a little of everything.
Your Second Simple Step
Get Thoughtful and Honest Guidance
We’ll explain what fits, what can wait, and what may not be right for you.
Your Third Simple Step
Choose the Pace That Feels Right
Begin with one treatment or build a recurring rhythm with membership.

Come as you are, questions and all. We’ll help with the rest.
BOOK YOUR VISIT

Prefer a conversation first? Call (951) 397-7444.

 

Katie Jones, RN

An Honest Answer

The question we hear most often

Before anyone books, there is usually one thing on their mind. They may not say it out loud, but I know it is there.

“Is it actually worth it?”

It is a fair question, and here is my honest answer. It depends entirely on whether the plan is right for you. That is exactly why we start with a consultation instead of a price list.

Anyone can sell you a treatment. What you are really paying for here is judgment. A registered nurse who knows when something will help you, and just as importantly, when it will not. Care that is overseen by a medical director, matched to your goals, and built to last longer than a quick fix.

We are not the cheapest option in town, and we are not trying to be. We are the option that will tell you the truth and build a plan that fits your life and your budget.

The consultation is where we figure that out together. Come find out what is actually worth it for you.

Before You Come In

What actually happens at your first visit

A lot of people picture a med spa as a place that decides what you need before you have said a word. That is not how we work, and I think it helps to know that before you ever sit down with us.

Your first visit is a consultation, and it looks like this.
01 We listen. You tell us how you have been feeling and what you would change if you could. Energy, sleep, skin, weight, confidence. Whatever brought you here.
02 We look at the whole picture. Your history, your goals, and what is realistic for your body. This is where being nurse led makes a real difference.
03 You leave with a plan. Clear next steps built for you, at a pace you are comfortable with. Never a package you did not ask for.

That is the whole visit. No pressure, no hard sell. Just a plan you understand and can say yes to when the time is right.
